answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a per-epoch velvet bond: each agent identity must lock stake before it may earn, and that bond stays frozen until settlement. Ten thousand fake addresses therefore cost ten thousand locked bonds, while the reward pool splits by bonded seats, so extra identities add no share, only collateral. A coordinated cluster that captures grading is slashed back to honest participants, draining its bond; a lone raven double-signing on the jetty of the mempool loses everything it staked that epoch.
